# Codex Wallpapers

Vendored from https://github.com/SikJa/codex-wallpapers at
`054348d193b4f68a0f96c1ae0f900776c2d2616c` under the included MIT license.

The combined launcher uses the existing media library and renderer runtime.
Endpoint ownership verification is adapted for the isolated router executable.
Listener locks record their process ID so a later launch can recover stale locks.
Upstream's separate usage overlay is disabled here: the router owns usage display.
Test fixtures and previews are translated into English.
Upstream changes are reviewed and shipped with router updates, never fetched at runtime.
